text:
priya: Heads up — sentinel raised repeated control-plane flaps in eu-west-1 while 3.4.1 canaries were running. We should embargo any further rollouts into EU and quiesce in-flight canaries. @deploy-bot can you stop new slot allocations?

deploy-bot: Quiescing rollout rl-2024-09-18-42. Active canaries halted, queued slots=6. Current pinned serving variant for EU -> v3.4.0 (previous stable v3.3.9). To resume: `deploy-bot resume rl-2024-09-18-42 --confirm`.

ops-oncall: We're seeing repeated envoy / control-plane restarts tied to a new circuit-breaker change in 3.4.1. Traffic shaping asymmetry causing control-plane churn. Initial mitigation: cordon a subset of hosts and fail fast, investigating root cause now.

tom: Quick question — do we want to rollback canaries only or perform a global revert? Rollback is lower blast radius but might hide latent issues.

priya: Prefer to embargo (freeze) new releases into EU for now and not flip global revert yet. Update release board and notify PMs. If canary restarts continue after infra remediation, we'll rollback the canary and pin stable.

sara: I'll update the release board and change windows. Propose new retry window 02:00-04:00 UTC with extended health checks and circuit-breaker off for the first two canaries.

lucas: Adding health gates to the rollout plan: require `kvcache p50 < 20ms` and `control-plane restarts < 1/min` for canary progression. Will push a canary config snippet to the PR.

priya: Also, let's prepare release notes blurb: note the incident and the embargoed window. If we end up pinning to v3.3.9, update docs and customers.

deploy-bot: Note on rollback safety: 3.4.1 has no DB migrations. Safe rollback available: `deploy-bot rollback rl-2024-09-18-42 --target v3.3.9 --safe`. If using hotfix, create new rollout id.

ops-oncall: Root cause looks like a nil deref in the circuit-breaker when a specific route set is empty. Patch is ready for 3.4.2. Recommend two-track approach: A) attempt hotfix canary (3.4.2) with tightened gates; B) if hotfix shows instability, execute safe rollback to v3.3.9 and keep EU embargo for 24h.

tom: Sounds good. I'll line up the release note update and stamp approvals. Who will own the postmortem?

sara: I'll own the postmortem + timeline, will tag eng-sre and product leads. Will draft PIR and timeline.

priya: Thanks. Action items: 1) ops-oncall to push hotfix 3.4.2 canary in 30m with tight gates, 2) deploy-bot hold on new rollouts into EU until 02:00 UTC, 3) tom/sara update release board and customer comms, 4) if hotfix fails -> deploy-bot execute safe rollback to v3.3.9 and pin for 24h. Keep thread updated.

lucas: On it — prepping canary config and telemetry dashboards. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Pushing 3.4.2 canary now to isolated subset. Will report back within 20m with first health snapshot.

priya: Great. Thanks everyone — keep replies short here so we keep the runbook clear.
